about: Every OpenStreetMap tag MapNG cares about, what it builds for it, and the game's own models that stand for it. status: built | partial | planned | ignored. tests/osmTagLibrary.test.mjs keeps it in step with the code (What to build, what is fetched, the models the code names) and with data/game-model-catalogue.json, where each model's size, anchor and materials are. A model's entry: usedToday (the code places it now), from: "catalogue" (listed by scripts/tag-library/from-catalogue.mjs from the picture review of 2026-11-15), maybe (needs a decision before use), picture (what its photo shows, where that is not what the code uses it for), seen (looked at in the running game). A model from another level needs that level's materials shipped with the export: public/beamng_shape_materials.json, made by scripts/build-shape-material-library.py.
